The '''Model 9 forearm grip''' was a [[Forearm grip/Legends|forearm grip]] manufactured by [[Galactic Arms]] and available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It cost 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
